map.生成算法：种子串按 Java 风格乘 31 哈希（hash = hash×31: Generation algorithm: the seed string is hashed Java-style with multiply-by-31 (hash = hash×31 + character code, wrapping as a 32-bit integer) and the absolute value taken; hue = hash mod 360, foreground = hsl(hue, 65%, 45%); then an LCG pseudo-random sequence s = (s×9301 + 49297) mod 233280 decides each cell, filling when s÷233280 > 0.5, with the left and right columns mirrored. Validation: the output size is clamped to ≥40 and the grid count clamped to 3–9. Criterion: the same seed always yields the same pattern, and different seeds yield different patterns.
